data.title: 三司绫濑 · 幕布后的一分钟
data.description: 演出即将开始，绫濑站在幕布后检查外套的领口。听到音乐响起，她抬起头，准备走向台前。
data.action: adjusting her coat collar behind a curtain
data.promptProse: Standing in the tight, shadowed space just behind the heavy velvet stage curtain, Ayase meticulously adjusts the high collar of her performance coat, her expression shifting into pure professional focus. Bright, high-contrast beams of white stage light spill through the edge of the curtain, illuminating dust particles dancing in the air and casting long, sharp shadows over the complex backstage rigging and stage cables visible in the dim background.
